about.title: About LLMField
about.backgroundDesc: LLMField is an open-source data project maintained by AI enthusiasts, collecting and curating publicly available data on Chinese LLMs to serve as a reference for developers and researchers. This site does not produce data — all data comes from public sources.
about.backgroundContribute: If you spot an error or would like to add new model information, feel free to submit an issue on
about.scoringDesc: This page displays raw benchmark scores from public evaluation frameworks, covering intelligence, coding, and agent dimensions, along with speed, multi-source pricing, and OpenRouter token volume data. Users can sort by any dimension.
about.scoringDetail: The Intelligence Index combines benchmarks like MMLU, HumanEval, and MATH to evaluate reasoning, coding, and math capabilities using a standardized 0-100+ scoring system.
about.costDetail: Pricing data integrates multiple sources: the detail page shows three tiers — CN official pricing (¥), Artificial Analysis pricing ($), and OpenRouter pricing ($). The table cost column uses OpenRouter USD pricing for consistent comparison.
about.filterDesc: From all models indexed by Artificial Analysis, we filter for Chinese vendors' large-scale models, inject vendor links and OpenRouter token volume data, and retain models released within the last 180 days.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai) is an authoritative LLM performance evaluation organization providing standardized benchmarks and data.
about.sourceAaDetail: The Intelligence Index combines multiple benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, etc.) to evaluate reasoning, coding, and math capabilities with a standardized scoring system.
about.priceSourceDesc: Multi-source: Official sites, Artificial Analysis, OpenRouter
about.priceDetail: Detail page shows three pricing tiers: CN official pricing (¥/M Tokens), Artificial Analysis API pricing ($/M Tokens), and OpenRouter market pricing ($/M Tokens). Table cost column uses OpenRouter pricing for consistency. Price data updated weekly.
about.orDesc: OpenRouter is the world's largest LLM API routing platform, providing unified API access and model routing. It publishes weekly token consumption rankings for all models.
about.orDetail: We collect OpenRouter's public weekly token volume rankings and API pricing data. Token volume reflects real-world model usage popularity; API pricing reflects market transaction prices.
about.updateDesc: Data is continuously tracked for new model versions and pricing changes, with regular updates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This site is for reference only and does not constitute investment or usage advice. Model performance varies by use case, and actual experience may differ from the data presented.
